topic: 名词复数与可数 / 不可数名词
summary: 可数名词有单复数之分，不可数名词没有复数、不能用 a/an，也不能直接加数词。

rules.title: 规则复数：加 -s / -es
rules.detail: 一般加 s（books）；以 s、x、ch、sh 结尾加 es（boxes，watches）；辅音字母+y 结尾变 y 为 i 加 es（city → cities）；以 f/fe 结尾多变 f 为 v 加 es（knife → knives）。

examples.en: There are many cities in China.

rules.title: 常见不规则复数
rules.detail: man → men，woman → women，child → children，foot → feet，tooth → teeth，mouse → mice；sheep、deer 单复数同形。

examples.en: There are forty students in our class.
How many children does she have?

rules.title: 不可数名词：water, milk, rice, bread, meat, paper, homework...
rules.detail: 没有复数形式，不能用 a/an 或数词直接修饰；表示数量用「a / 数字 + 量词 + of」：a glass of milk，two cups of tea。

examples.en: I'd like some bread and milk.
examples.zh: 我想要一些面包和牛奶。

examples.en: There are two bottles of water on the desk.

signals: a lot of 两者皆可
pitfalls: 不可数名词加 s：❌ two milks → ✓ two glasses of milk
how many / how much 混用：how many + 可数复数（How many books?）；how much + 不可数（How much water?）
some / any：some 用于肯定句，any 常用于否定句和疑问句

questions.stem: There are three ___ and five ___ in the picture.
questions.explain: sheep 单复数同形；cow 的复数是 cows。

questions.stem: How many ___ are there in the room?
questions.explain: woman 的复数是不规则变化 women。
orange（橙汁）不可数，不加 s；量词 glass 要变复数：two glasses of orange。

questions.stem: ___ rice would you like? — Two bowls, please.
questions.explain: rice 是不可数名词，用 how much 提问数量。

questions.stem: Look! There are many ___ (child) playing in the park.
questions.explain: child 的复数是不规则变化 children。
辅音字母+y 结尾，变 y 为 i 加 es：babies。
tomato 以 o 结尾，复数加 es：tomatoes（类似 potato → potatoes）。

questions.stem: There are five people in my family and we often eat fishes together.
questions.explain: fish 表示「鱼肉」（不可数）或同种鱼（单复数同形），此处指吃的鱼，用 fish。

questions.stem: 桌上有三杯果汁。（翻译整句）
answer: there are three glasses of juice on the table.
there are three cups of juice on the table.
questions.explain: juice 不可数；数量用「数词 + 量词复数 + of」。

questions.stem: 我妈妈每天买很多蔬菜。（翻译整句）
answer: my mother buys a lot of vegetables every day.
my mom buys a lot of vegetables every day.
my mother buys many vegetables every day.
questions.explain: vegetable 可数，常用复数 vegetables；a lot of / many 修饰可数复数。
